newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil judge rules against Band B cellular tender.
newsitem.headline: Brazil judge rules against Band B cellular tender.

text.p: A Brazilian judge granted an injunction against the privatization of Band B cellular concessions in the northeastern state of Pernambuco, local newspapers said on Thursday.

Judge Edwiges Caradolo Wanderley granted an injunction requested by Communications Workers Union in Pernambuco which questioned the constitutionality of a nine-month old telecommunications law, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said.

On Monday, 15 groups presented bids to operate Band B cellular services in nine of 10 concession areas. The state of Pernambuco is part of the number 10 concession area, which also includes Alagoas, Ceara, Paraiba, Piaui and Rio Grande do Norte states.
Gazeta said seven consortia presented bids for that area.
